feat(renderer): a copy click's act is a copy effect the host performs, and a failed copy shows on the bar (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.zty)

The copy and copy-diagnostic verbs hand their text to the click's `copy`,
which the click turn returns as a `copy` effect. The renderer host performs
it through the clipboard part after the turn, on both outcomes (TurnThrew
carries effects, as it carries subscriptions), and hands the outcome back as
its `effect-done`. Which turn returns which effect is one table, so a present
from a non-request turn and a copy from a non-click turn are refused.

A failed copy is a daemon-wide held event under the one event-hold rule: the
URL handler reads no reply and a copy names no session, so the bar is the only
place a person sees it. pbcopy no longer runs inside the journal turn.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.220.0
